candidateObservations.caption: Spirit Halloween's Freddy Fazbear animatronic just had its first real-world debut, showing up on a dedicated stage at the retailer's flagship store. The full-scale prop went viral after fans saw the $500 animatronic performing in stores for the first time.  Freddy stands on a stage styled after Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, complete with red curtains, a brick backdrop, and an illuminated Five Nights at Freddy's sign, and fans can trigger his performance using a paw-print step pad, which makes him wave, raise his mic, and sway while his eyes light up and games audio plays.  At $499.99, he's priced as one of Spirit Halloween's most expensive props for the 2026 season. Reaction has been mixed, with some fans excited to own a full-size Freddy and others questioning whether an audible squeak in his movements is acceptable at that price.
